stem:
To study the water cycle, students add ice cubes to a glass of water. Ten minutes later they observe the glass. On the outside of the glass, students see drops of water.

Which statement explains the students’ observations?

options.label: A
options.text: Water vapor has become liquid water.

options.label: B
options.text: Solid water has become liquid water.

options.label: C
options.text: Liquid water has become water vapor.

options.label: D
options.text: Solid water has become water vapor.
